scope: Synthetic lexical retrieval and context regression evidence; not semantic truth or v1.0 readiness.

observed_metrics.definition: Recall divides unique relevant top-five hits by all annotated relevant notes; reciprocal rank is censored at five; empty relevance is null and excluded from macro means, with exact zero-hit checks.

observed_interfaces.mcp_consumer: Independent initialized stdio process with tools/list guidance/schema checks; no CLI skill files loaded.

detailed_report: .build/retrieval-quality.json (generated locally and retained as a CI artifact)
limits: Compact authored synthetic judgments, not a representative multilingual benchmark or arbitrary semantic relevance proof.
Whole-token lexical intersection and literal candidate filtering only; no Boolean/field grammar, arbitrary Unicode substrings, emoji-only matching, stemming, embeddings or semantic paraphrases.
Unverified trust fixtures only; existing tests retain verification/dependency, pagination, relationship, path/parser, recovery, concurrency, performance and package coverage.
Token estimates use UTF-8 bytes divided by four, rounded up, not a model-specific tokenizer.
Required full repository/package validation is reported separately in the pull request; these metrics alone do not establish it.
